content.short: Resolv is a decentralized protocol issuing USR, a delta-neutral stablecoin backed by crypto.
content.description: Resolv is a pioneering DeFi protocol that issues USR, a decentralized stablecoin designed to maintain stability through a delta-neutral hedging strategy. By pairing its underlying cryptocurrency collateral (such as ETH and BTC) with corresponding short futures positions, Resolv effectively neutralizes market volatility. This allows users to hold a stable asset that is backed by transparent, on-chain crypto assets while avoiding the risks associated with traditional centralized stablecoin issuers. The protocol provides a scalable and robust alternative for on-chain dollar liquidity.
